messages:
Maya: Quick ping 1/v1/generate API ref has mixed field names. Top schema uses 'input' (backend), but inline examples and snippets still show 'prompt'. Docs CI failed on schema mismatch. Can someone own this?

Chris: I can take it. We should standardize on 'input' (matches runtime) and add a short migration note mapping 'prompt' -> 'input'. Also the streaming section should show SSE with named events (chunk/done) rather than raw JSONL.

Anjali: Plan: 1) update api-reference/generate.md examples (curl/python/node) to use 'input' and 'max_tokens', 2) add "Streaming responses" subsection with explicit SSE snippet, 3) add Compatibility blurb at top linking to migration example, 4) regenerate SDK snippets after OpenAPI change. I'll open branch docs/generate-sse-migrate.

Maya: Thanks. Small CI tip  run 'make docs-validate' locally; validator versions differ between CI and some dev containers. Pinning jsonschema in the docs devcontainer helped me.

Anjali: Draft SSE example to include in PR:
```
# curl SSE example
curl -N -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -d '{"input":"Summarize the release notes","stream":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# server sends lines like:
event: chunk
data: {"delta":"Added a new"}
event: chunk
data: {"delta":" batching option"}
event: done
data: {"id":"resp_900","status":"complete"}
```

Chris: After you push the OpenAPI update, I'll run the snippet generator (pinned to v0.9.2) and paste regenerated python/node/java samples into examples/snippets.

Docs-bot: linked issue #3001 -> PR 7102 opened by Anjali (label: docs:needs-review)

Maya: PR link when ready? I'll review after CI passes. Please include a one-line Compatibility note at top so customers see the rename immediately. :thumbsup:
